sourceSubject: Merged PR 19956: add console log for branch sync testing

requirements.behavior: Diagnostic console message when leaving campaign details
requirements.rationale: The event only adds console.log('Branch sync test console log') after existing ngOnDestroy cleanup; all other edits are trailing commas. The frozen target's standalone ViewCampaignComponent retains the same cleanup dispatches and subscription teardown without this diagnostic message. No user-facing behavior or migration contract requires adaptation.
